target: AI Hub synthetic electronic-transfer 이상거래여부; not verified for real transactions
split_policy: fit all training rows through 2023Q3; tune/threshold training 2023Q4; retrospective evaluation validation 2024
history_policy: detailed same-sender prior 90 calendar days plus all-time prior aggregates; exclude all same-day transactions; historical raw inputs from both training and validation, labels never used
label_usage_policy: Only pre-2023Q4 training labels enter fit; only 2023Q4 training labels select model and threshold. All 2024 training labels are excluded from fit and selection. Earlier raw events may be used as unlabeled context only.

source_quality.duplicate_policy: Retained: no unique transaction ID, so identical date and three-hour-bucket inputs may be repeated real events in the synthetic source.
source_quality.ordering_limit: No reliable event order within a day; all same-day events excluded from historical features.
source_quality.evaluation_limit: 2024 has been examined previously; this is a retrospective synthetic-label evaluation, not a blinded real-world test.

threshold_policy.objective: maximize 2023Q4 F1 subject to <=2% alert rate

same_amount_discrimination.interpretation: Pairwise rank discrimination among transactions with the same amount; retrospective 2024 synthetic validation.

tuning.interpretation: Model score is not a verified fraud probability; calibration is retrospective on synthetic labels.

validation.interpretation: Model score is not a verified fraud probability; calibration is retrospective on synthetic labels.

missing_history_stress.interpretation: Counterfactual removal of all history from the same 2024 rows. This is an input-availability stress test; it is not an observed cold-start cohort or verified fresh-clone accuracy.

duplicate_input_audit.key: all nine current raw fields including date; labels excluded
duplicate_input_audit.overlap_basis: Exact key includes date. Fit ends 2023-09-30, development is 2023Q4, validation is 2024: disjoint date ranges prohibit exact-key overlap.
duplicate_input_audit.unlabeled_context_overlap_limit: 2024 training labels are never fitted or selected; matching raw input can still recur in coarse source timestamps. Same-day history is excluded.

threshold_tradeoffs.interpretation: Development targets do not guarantee the same precision or alert rate after distribution shift.

development_group_permutation.source: 2023Q4 training holdout only; 100000-row random diagnostic sample
development_group_permutation.interpretation: Permutation changes model inputs jointly; it is global sensitivity, not an individual causal reason.

target_definition.positive_label: Synthetic source 이상거래여부=1, binary label only; an alert is a review signal, not proof of financial fraud.
target_definition.negative_label: Synthetic source 이상거래여부=0; no alert is not a guarantee that a transaction is safe.
scope_limits: Binary model does not identify a fraud subtype or establish intent.
Reliable within-day order and inbound-account balance are absent; same-day multi-event mechanisms cannot be reconstructed completely.
Source subtype descriptions and labels never enter input features; evaluation measures agreement with these synthetic labels.
Real-bank fraud detection, unseen fraud patterns, and economic loss reduction have not been validated.

uncertainty_policy: Wilson intervals treat labeled rows as independent trials; repeated and account-correlated events can make real uncertainty larger. No real-world fraud-rate or production guarantee is implied.
